rationale: Externalized embedding recipe (Wave 2 SOTA++). Includes sensory_summary (body/acidity/tannin/sweetness — 79-100% populated, previously lost), pairing tags, flavor profiles, and capped Korean aliases so '오푸스원' and 'Opus One' embed into the same neighborhood without round-tripping through the alias index. Field weights are realized as repeated tokens (Algolia/Elastic-style weighted concat): weight=1.0 → 1 copy, weight=0.5 → 1 copy emitted only when the field is present (no fractional copies — see field_weight_strategy). Bump 'version' when ANY field, prefix, weight, or strategy changes so the embedding reuse cache (semantic_summary equality) invalidates.
field_weight_strategy_note: Each field with weight w contributes max(1, floor(w * MULTIPLIER)) repetitions when present. MULTIPLIER=1 keeps text short. We do NOT emit fractional copies (would yield non-deterministic outputs across calls). Fields with weight <= 0 are skipped entirely.

fields.name: producer
fields.rationale: Producer name disambiguates wines with overlapping labels (DOC fault domain).

fields.name: flavor_profiles
fields.rationale: Flavor tags (black-fruit, oak, citrus) are explicit semantic anchors.

fields.name: pairing_tags
fields.rationale: Food pairings encode meal-occasion intent that pure tasting notes miss.

fields.name: sensory_summary
fields.rationale: Numeric grounding for body/acidity/tannin/sweetness — previously not embedded at all.
